_comment: Resource types included in the FREE base pack that ships embedded in the scanner binary. These are the types a typical AWS Terraform repo is mostly made of, so the free tier detects real problems on real code rather than being a demo. The paid full pack covers every resource type the provider ships (~1700) and is generated from the same source, so the two can never disagree about a type they share — the paid pack simply knows about more of them. Changing this list changes what the free tier covers, so treat it as a product decision, not a data update.
